football_evidence.assessment: No material disagreement: EdgeDesk and the line are within 1.0 points.
supporting: When Iowa State has the ball (the line of scrimmage on running plays): Iowa State’s offense is stopped at or behind the line on 22.4% of its runs, and Oklahoma State’s defense stops 22.1% of opponent runs at or behind the line (FBS average 17.5%).

When Oklahoma State has the ball (big plays through the air): Oklahoma State’s offense turns 16.9% of its pass plays into explosive gains, and Iowa State’s defense gives up explosive gains on 11.5% of opponent pass plays (FBS average 10.2%).

When Oklahoma State has the ball (the line of scrimmage on running plays): Oklahoma State’s offense is stopped at or behind the line on 10.0% of its runs, and Iowa State’s defense stops 14.7% of opponent runs at or behind the line (FBS average 17.5%).
